title: 風はつぼみを揺らしたか

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I find Yamanin Zephyr—who I've never seen express an interest in other runners—staring intently at the TV.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look at the screen to see Tokai Teio declaring her intention to become an undefeated Triple Crown champion, like the Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, her ultimate goal lies beyond that—her dream is to become a "Monarch" who surpasses the Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr is greatly shocked by the notion, having never even considered the idea of surpassing her own idol, the Mile Emperor.
